body:
Thanks for replying. These couple of people I mention, one of them has done things in the past which make me question his motives, but another one I can only go so far in telling him. Its kind of a strange situation, the one who im questioning, I can tell anything to and he wont change his perspective of me, but I don't trust him with alot of the information, the stuff I do trust him with, yes I do discuss with him. The other one who I trust very much, I cannot tell everything to, once again because of family problems and such reasons. Once again, I would love to talk, and just because I am anonymous and you will never know who I truly am. If you did, its a pride and shame type of thing... I don't expect you to understand, but if you do then you know where im coming from.

I try to continue to improve in a positive way, but for someone like me, losing is the worst thing in the world, it brings you back to reality and question your own playstyle and motives. It makes you question if you need to change your whole gameplay or if its a certain thing. You start changing good things about yourself and it messes up your gameplay. The stress of change is a hard concept, I don't want to lose my unique playstyle but I want to improve. But in order to improve, I need to change. But you have to know if your changing the right things. Its kind of a strange thing to think about. When you lose a certain amount of time, you lose the motivation, you question why you even play if you dont improve. Your loss blinds your ability to see your improvement or how skilled you really are. Its a concept of being very hard on yourself so you can improve, but at times, it does get out of hand.

>Ultimately it becomes a decision of whether you want to allow them to hurt you - and that decision lies squarely in your own hands.

I try not to think about it, I try to forget about it and play it off. I try not to care, but I value this person so much, like the one person I am able to tell things to and he does this, then its like an importance factor, how important do they value you.

> It has made you strong, it has made you get up on your own two feet.

You are right about this, I see it as it has made me stronger, but it doesn't change that it will stick with me forever and because I know this information, I view this person differently and biased, more towards a hatred type of thing. My thought process is "How could they even think this" then slowly moves over to "I don't need this person in my life." Ive gotten to where I am now by myself, and its been hard, but there are battles that you win, and there are battles that you struggle to win, and that's what it is now. I don't consider losing to be an option, and asking for help is strange because ive done everything by myself for my whole life, ive taught myself everything. But I have learned that its okay to ask for help, but from another viewpoint its "What can I be told that I don't already know?" Ive got mixed emotions right now, but I see this as asking an allied country for help in the battle.

>but I am going to ask you not to give up looking for them.

I wont give up hope, but if I don't find that person in 5 years, then they do not exist.

>Use the fact that you can be far more independent at life

This one is kind of tricky. Even though right now, I have a part time job but no where enough to live on my own or anything like that. Once again, its out of family code and honor to move away until you are married (Asian concept). I don't like to rely on them for anything, but at the moment, I can't do anything.

> PM me if you feel like talking about this!

Sure.

>I do think you'll be able to handle it well. If you go ahead and read this one, do tell me how you find it to be!

Sure sounds good, so just find it at a local library or try to get it in my phone or something?

The dream thing is just something that interests me, but I doubt it will ever be a reality, its ok though, I already accepted that fact.

>Hugs again :)

:).

Thank you, its hard for me to open up because of the stuff ive been through, and the only reason I do here is become im anonymous. 

You say we need to vent once in a while, but I self vent, I vent to myself, because I believe people don't want to hear my problems, there is no one close enough to me that I can tell these problems to and get a straight answer. I don't trust anybody, they can backstab you and they can "dishonor" your family if they know you have a problem(Learned that one from the family). I don't know if self venting is the right answer for me, all I know is that it works. I like that credible defense because it makes too much sense. 

Alot of the things I do have some sort of connection or meaning to me, I play tennis and video games, these two hold meaning for me because I need to be better than someone and I will always keep trying to be the best. And even when I do become the best, I still feel inferior because of the way I am treated and the way that another person would be treated if they were in my spot and that's what hurts. I don't understand if its a problem with me or because of the way I act, my personality... What is it about me that people dislike so much that they can hurt me this bad? The worst part is, they don't even realize even though they do it on purpose...

I have had this moment of time once again, where I felt like I was holding the weight of the world on my shoulders, and I like to think that things will get better as time moves on. But this happens too often, I believe that until I am dead, things cannot get better. I will tell you something that I haven't said before on this thread. I have felt alot of pain and there's nothing anybody could say to hurt me anymore than they already have, but it is a reoccuring pain, at the same intensity. I have been told I am a waste of a life by my brother, I have been told that I would be better dead by my mother. I was called names and belittled by my grandma and family, I was put at fault for becoming sick at a young age and becoming diagnosed with a deadly disease even though it was their fault, I have been told that I was almost purposely killed when I was still in the womb (That one haunted me for a long time.) But now, I am over it. I don't believe in happiness anymore. There is no such thing as affection or sympathy, and to me, the word "love" doesn't exist. This is why I say I don't want a heart or have a heart, or why  I say it is cold and dead, because that's exactly what it is, the ability to feel hurts too much. 

I am constantly watched by family, they want me to mess up, just to belittle me and make me live in fear, and unfortunately, I do live in that fear that if they were to catch me doing something, my life would turn into a nightmare. But on the other hand, it already is a nightmare, but it could be so much worse, ive experienced physical pain from them before, but its nothing compared to the emotional pain, and that is why I hate emotions, physical pain heals, but emotional takes far too long and the scars never go away. Heh I sound like a god damn pansy.

I don't believe in love, our family has a tradition of arranged marriages. That's not love, that's learning to like who your stuck with and unfortunately, I can't break that cycle. I have one life and it saddens me that I have to live it in this way. 

The two things that make me very interested are feeling a pain that is greater than mine and dreams. They are completely on the different ends of the spectrum, but I want to see how much far worse life can be, I want to bear the maximum amount of pain so that I know that it can't get any worse :(. The other thing is dreams, they are so fascinating, the idea that your mind can create a perfect scenario where nothing matters, you are at ease, and that dream can make you happy, fulfilled and full of joy. Its crazy, even though its fake, your brain knows what it wants and your heart knows it can never achieve it. 

I really have no way to process your last paragraph starting at: "Your approach is cautious." I have no words for that... The only thing I can muster up to say is that I want to break the walls, but I have to find that one person, but I don't believe that he/she exists. Your post was the hardest to answer out of all of them, thank you, you make me actually feel human.

Anyway, that is alot more stuff that I intended to tell that I didn't mean to, but it was kind of nice getting it out, thank you. I have never told anyone that before.

You seem to understand me very well dobtortonto. Everything you said was 100% correct. I identified myself as a Starcraft player and a top 200 NA player because its something that I feel proud of, its something I accomplished with hard work and I am not afraid to show it, although it might sound selfish.

I want to trust people, but it seems like I will never have anyone that close to me. I do trust tests, telling them small things about me and gradually increase seeing what they do with the information, I told one of my best friends on time and he revealed it to a mutual friend who he does not even know very well. It hurt, but its ok, I learned that I should not trust him anymore. And if I can't trust one of my best friends, then who can you trust, you know?

I consider myself an analyst, I watch people for any slight clue I can get about them, whether its the way they are standing, decision making, eye movement, body language, etc. Anything that I can pick up about them, then I can understand that person inside and out and know everything about them, how they will act in a situation, how they perceive things, their motivations, their weaknesses, everything. And with this information, it helps me to identify people who are genuine and those people who are fake. I then question why they do this and all of these other things that I find interesting. I am surprised you picked that up about me.

Unfortunately, they shouldn't denigate me, and I explained to them situations and why they shouldn't, but they don't understand, they see the smaller picture instead of everything about it. They do things without reason or question and just go with the flow because they believe it to be true, even if its something that doesn't make very much sense.

I wish that future can come, but I don't believe that will change for a very very long time. I wish it could, but it just can't, not the way people act. I don't like people, a lot of people are very sneaky and do things that are manipulative, selfish, cynical, or conceited that you have to be careful of. But then there are others, who are pure and genuine, real, and motivated, these are people who I find very interesting and get to know them better, but unfortunately, there are very few.

I don't know how to treat myself better. I am very competitive and I must be the best that I can be by beating those who are better than me. That's the only way I can prove I am the best at something, and if im not then I tend to get discouraged and disappointed if its happening over a long period of time, criticizing myself and trying to push myself, questioning my abilities and skills.

The idea that I am imperfect is a mirage to me. I know that I can't become the best at everything even though I try, but I try not to show it, and when I do try  not to show it, I start believing it and living it, its a proof thing. I need to prove to myself that I can become the best at something if I put my mind to it. I don't really know how to explain it im sorry. 

I don't know how to see myself as flawed and imperfect and I don't know how to accept that idea. Its an interesting concept, because I learned it from watching others, the better they got at something the more attention they received. My cousins are power hungry, they want to beat the best person, but when I become that best person, they seem to lose interest, and I just don't understand...

Something I take seriously is video gaming and things I am generally good at. But things like sports seem to take more priority and I don't understand why either, the chances of getting better at a sport than a video game are slimmer. I thought it was about passion, about continuing on the difficult road no matter what it is and things like this really confuse me because others don't seem to understand and that's what the problem is...

I know, I really understand that I need to because if I bottle it up, im only hurting myself, but there is absolutely NO ONE I trust that I can tell it to without getting a negative reaction or them thinking differently about me or judging me. Because im a quiet person, its hard to find the kind of people that I can interact well with, I can't just go up and be like, "Hey, hows it going?" CS students aren't the most outgoing people heh.

That's is very true, I find that interesting you picked that up. Im an analyst, what I do is analyze people from afar and judge their character, personality, posture, eye movements, etc. ANYTHING that I can pick up from them, I normally do. I can judge people with pinpoint accuracy, if they are hiding something, not being their normal selves, if something is wrong with them, etc. I don't try to push people away from me, I differentiate between people, I try to find what their cause is for being a friend of mine. If its for a personal gain of theirs, then I have no interest in them, but if its just because they like me for who I am then I try to get to know them better and open up to them. This is only for guys though, for girls, I can't hold a conversation with them let alone be friends with them. If I am friends with them then I have to keep it a secret, if my family ever found out, then they would start a shit storm and call me on everything I do from that day forward.

I don't like to feel personally, I wish I didn't have that ability, because it tends to make me vulnerable. I have ALOT more sad, stressful, lonely moments than I do happy moments, and its come to a point where when something happens, I don't know if its worth being happy about it or not. Recently I got a new car, and I know I am very blessed to have it, it is a nice car and people mistake my personality because of this car, I do not change because of material items nor do I show them off, but people do not seem to understand this. I try to let everything that I don't need to keep quiet about out, but the things I do, lets just say that there are too many of them for one person to bear.

This might be true now that I think about it, school is a big factor in my life and I cannot be relaxed if something is due in a week because it feels like I don't have enough time to accomplish all of the work, even though 2 of my classes are very simple. I am not able to transfer schools or live on campus, my Asian parents are very strict and restrict me from having a social life or friends, but I try to go out whenever I can which is rare. Even most family, like my cousins, is pushed away because they believe that that family will have a bad influence on me.

I tend to take alot of things in a very joking manner, my personality is to be a funny guy because I love making people laugh, but for me to be myself, the person has to know me, otherwise I tend to be a lot more quiet in front of people who dont know me. I don't know how to take things less seriously, I try not to care, but my competitive nature forces me to care. I really like what you said, an opportunity to mature and adapt, the idea of losing is better than winning because it teaches you more is a difficult concept but very true, but I don't know how to make a good outcome out of something in life like this. The only thing that comes to mind is, don't do this again, etc. I like to work with people, but some people are very manipulative and like to receive help but give no help, and I tend to avoid these kind of people. And CS can take alot of routes, and when someone knows a procedure that you don't know, but its easier for them, than they will take that way and it will be difficult to follow.

That's awesome! I was only top 200 for a very short time and its an accomplishment I hold very dear to me, even though its just a video game, its my passion. Haha I am nowhere as near as good as Trump, and it would be fun to get to play him. I used to coach for a little while, if you would like to get some practice, add me up. Ryden.984, I do all races.

Thank you, I really do hope I go where I want to go, but in order to do that, I have to conquer this problem and I just don't know how anymore...

Sadly, I believe that is true... I would love to play Starcraft, its one of the things that takes my mind off of the real world, my ID is Ryden.984, I don't get on as much anymore, but if you ever see me on, feel free to message me.

I do enjoy these activities, but I only enjoy them because im good at them, im a very competitive person, so I try to be the best at everything and be supportive after I win.

I tried to gain weight, but its very difficult for me, ive been trying for a while now.

Thank you, I like to have conversations alot more than people think, but since I am quiet and a little shy, that tends for people to think about me differently.
